description: This Swift file defines an enum GatewayStatusBuilder with a static method build that constructs and returns a GatewayState based on the status information present in the NodeAppModel. It includes logic to interpret specific gateway status texts and map them to corresponding states.

classes.name: GatewayStatusBuilder
classes.description: A utility enum providing a static method to build GatewayState based on NodeAppModel status.

methods.name: build
methods.description: A static method that returns a GatewayState based on properties of NodeAppModel, specifically interpreting the gateway server name and status text to determine connection states.
